svg.title: Capital intensity and jobs
svg.desc: Simplified original concept map. Branches explain connected dimensions, not a timeline or a claim that one factor guarantees an outcome. Production inputs: Firms combine labour and capital to produce output. Capital intensity: More machinery per worker can raise output without an equal rise in employment. Interpretation: Check output, employment, productivity and job quality together; output growth alone is not a jobs measure.
